# Initial Setup and Package Loading

```{r Initialize working environment}

# Function to silently load packages without warnings or messages
load_packages <- function(pkgs) {
  invisible(
    lapply(pkgs, function(pkg) {
      suppressWarnings(
        suppressMessages(
          if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
            stop(paste("❌ Package not found:", pkg), call. = FALSE)
          }
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

# Vector of required packages
packages_needed <- c("tidyverse")

# Call the function to load them
load_packages(packages_needed)

# Print the information of the working session in order to ensure reproducibility
sessionInfo()

```

```{r Create working directory}

# NOTE: This script is expected to run without modifications if the repository
# is downloaded with its original folder structure from GitHub. If any file or
# directory paths are changed, the corresponding pathways in the script must be
# updated accordingly.

# Create directory within the file system to save the results of the analyses
dir.create("../data/outputs_script_3", recursive = TRUE, 
           showWarnings = FALSE)

```


# Construction of the PCR genotyping heatmap

```{r Data loading and reshaping}

# Load the PCR genotyping dataset
alkaloid_pcr <- read.table("../data/alkaloids_PCR.csv",
                            sep = ";", header = TRUE)

# Define metadata columns to exclude from the data reshaping process
meta_cols_pcr <- c("Hostsp", "IndividualID", "SampleID", "E")

# Store the original sample and gene order for later use in the visualization
sample_order_pcr <- alkaloid_pcr$SampleID
gene_order_pcr <- colnames(alkaloid_pcr)[!(colnames(alkaloid_pcr) %in%
                  meta_cols_pcr)]

# Reshape the dataset from wide to long format
alkaloid_pcr_lng <- alkaloid_pcr %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(meta_cols_pcr),
               names_to = "Gene",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Value = factor(Value, levels = c("-", "+")))

# Restore the original sample and gene ordering for plotting
alkaloid_pcr_lng$SampleID <- factor(alkaloid_pcr_lng$SampleID, 
                                    levels = sample_order_pcr)
alkaloid_pcr_lng$Gene<- factor(alkaloid_pcr_lng$Gene, 
                               levels = rev(gene_order_pcr))

```

```{r Constructing and exporting the PCR genotyping panel}

# Set the output directory for heatmap figure
out_dir_heat <- "../data/outputs_script_3"

# Generate the PCR genotyping heatmap
heatmap_pcr <- ggplot(alkaloid_pcr_lng, aes(x = SampleID, y = Gene)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "white", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Value, color = Value), size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("+" = "#2E8B57", "-" = "#8B0000")) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.50) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)  # less inner margins
  )

# Export the heatmap as a landscape-oriented PDF file
ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir_heat, "heatmap_pcr_genotyping.pdf"), 
       plot = heatmap_pcr, width = 11.14, height = 8.27, units = "in")

```

# Construction of the chemical heatmap

```{r Load alkaloids qualitative dataset and transform it}

# Load the qualitative alkaloid dataset
alkaloid_data <- read.table("../data/alkaloids_qualitative.csv",
                            sep = ";", header = TRUE)

# Define metadata columns to exclude from the data reshaping process
meta_cols <- c("Hostsp", "IndividualID", "SampleID", "E")

# Store the original sample and compound order for later use in the visualization
sample_order <- alkaloid_data$SampleID
compound_order <- colnames(alkaloid_data)[!(colnames(alkaloid_data) %in%
                  meta_cols)]

# Reshape the dataset from wide to long format
alkaloid_lng <- alkaloid_data %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(meta_cols),
               names_to = "Compound",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Value = factor(Value, levels = c("NO", "TRACES", "YES")))

# Restore the original sample and compound ordering for plotting
alkaloid_lng$SampleID <- factor(alkaloid_lng$SampleID,
                                levels = sample_order)
alkaloid_lng$Compound <- factor(alkaloid_lng$Compound,
                                levels = rev(compound_order))

```

```{r Constructing and exporting the chemical (qualitative) panel}

# Set the output directory for heatmap figure
out_dir_heat <- "../data/outputs_script_3"

# Define the colour palette for qualitative alkaloid categories
cols_heatmap <- c("NO" = "#D9D9D9", "TRACES" = "#F0C419", "YES" = "#0072B4")

# Generate the qualitative alkaloid heatmap
heatmap_qual <- ggplot(alkaloid_lng, aes(x = SampleID, y = Compound, fill = Value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_heatmap, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.50) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)  # less inner margins
)

# Export the heatmap as a landscape-oriented PDF file
ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir_heat, "heatmap_alkaloids_qual.pdf"), 
       plot = heatmap_qual, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, units = "in")

```
